metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (-41.729403, -125.410394) with 100km radius buffer - Time periods: Nov 2019 - Feb 2020 vs Nov 2018 - Feb 2019 - Collection: Ocean color data - MODIS Aqua or similar for chlorophyll concentration - Use MODIS/061/MYD09GA or better yet, ocean color product like "NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI" which has chlorophyll_a 2. Masking strategy: - Ocean color data typically has quality flags - May need to mask invalid/cloudy pixels - Focus on valid chlorophyll measurements 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If collections are empty → C1 - If valid pixel count is 0 after masking → C2 - If mean chlorophyll is None/NaN → C3 - If 2019-2020 > 2018-2019 → A (Yes, concentrations were up) - Otherwise → B (No, concentrations were not up) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-125.410394, -41.729403]); const roi = point.buffer(100000); // 100km radius // Time periods const period1_start = '2018-11-01'; const period1_end = '2019-03-01'; const period2_start = '2019-11-01'; const period2_end = '2020-03-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chlor_collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .select('chlor_a'); const col1 = chlor_collection .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(roi); const col2 = chlor_collection .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(roi); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (2018-19) Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (2019-20) Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("One or both periods have no data."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean chlorophyll for each period const mean1_img = col1.mean(); const mean2_img = col2.mean(); // Check valid pixel counts const count1_result = await mean1_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2_result = await mean2_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1 = count1_result.chlor_a || 0; const count2 = count2_result.chlor_a || 0; console.log(`Period 1 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean chlorophyll concentrations const stats1 = await mean1_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await mean2_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const chlor1 = stats1.chlor_a; const chlor2 = stats2.chlor_a; console.log(`Period 1 (2018-19) Mean Chlorophyll: ${chlor1}`); console.log(`Period 2 (2019-20) Mean Chlorophyll: ${chlor2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (chlor1 == null || chlor2 == null || isNaN(chlor1) || isNaN(chlor2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (chlor1 < 0 || chlor2 < 0 || chlor1 > 100 || chlor2 > 100) { console.log("Chlorophyll values out of valid range."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Difference: ${(chlor2 - chlor1).toFixed(4)} mg/m^3`); if (chlor2 > chlor1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
